summary: Final end-to-end frontend pass for Online Vaidhyaji AYUSH — Expo web preview at 390x844. Ran three integrated Playwright flows covering all 24 spec items across 3 personas (fresh patient, admin, and re-login). 23/24 items PASS. Only anomaly: on the admin dashboard the 'recent activity' section renders empty (0 cards) even though /admin/activity itself lists 52 entries with the admin token — appears to be a one-time race where the dashboard's initial useEffect fires the /api/admin/activity fetch before the freshly stored JWT is available in memory (a single 401 was logged to console at that moment). Non-blocking: navigating to Activity Log works, and stats cards render correctly. All other flows work: splash→onboarding auto-redirect (with ॐ brand + Hindi tagline), onboarding EN↔HI language toggle (title flips to 'ऑनलाइन वैद्यजी'), role selection (Patient + Vaidya cards), patient register→OTP (any 4 digits)→health-profile→home dashboard (Namaste greeting, daily-tip image card, bento with AI Vaidhyaji + Book Vaidya + Wellness Streaks, community challenges strip, floating support-chat headphones FAB), floating support-chat sends a message and receives an AI reply (~5-8s), AI Vaidhyaji chatbot receives Claude-Sonnet-4.5-powered reply for 'I have acidity' (~10s), all 5 bottom tabs (Home/Feed/Consult/Reminders/Profile) switch smoothly, Feed horizontal category chips (All/Daily Tips/Home Remedies/Yoga — actual testIDs are feed-chip-{all|tip|remedy|yoga}) filter content, Consult specialty chips scroll horizontally (6 chips) and doctor cards (6 seeded) tap through to detail, slot picker (13 slots visible across Today/Tomorrow/Tue), 'Pay & confirm' opens payment sheet and 'Pay ₹599' books and redirects to appointments with PAID pill, video-call screen renders with mic/cam/end mock controls, Add Rx demo modal saves and prescription appears in Records → Prescriptions tab, Records vault has both Prescriptions & Lab reports tabs (lab report create with title/kind chip/notes → visible → delete works), Reminders FAB opens sheet and reminder is created/deleted, Challenges 'Join challenge' toggles to 'Check-in today', Profile shows name + menu items + language toggle switches EN↔HI and persists across reload (AsyncStorage-backed vaidhyaji.lang key confirmed), admin login (admin@vaidhyaji.com / Admin@123) auto-routes to /admin/dashboard, all 6 stat cards + 3 action buttons render, Doctors screen filters (All/Pending/Verified) work, Approve pending doctor works (5 pending seed found, approved one and count decreased), '+' Add doctor modal creates new verified doctor visible in list, Patients screen shows 16 patients with tappable rows opening consultation history sheet, Activity Log shows 52 entries with icons and metadata. No red screens, no broken images observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Recent Activity list on the admin dashboard rendered 0 cards immediately after login while /admin/activity subroute correctly returned 52. A single 401 was captured in browser console at dashboard mount — the useEffect firing api.adminActivity() likely races with token persistence in the auth context. Refreshing the page or navigating back to dashboard should populate it. Consider awaiting `ready`/`token` from auth context before calling admin endpoints, or refetching in a focus effect.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted repeatedly on onboarding/home/consult screens. Reference: any style using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius — should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/RNW compatibility.

React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted on the register flow. Migrate `pointerEvents='none'` (etc.) to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` where used.

action_items: Fix the admin-dashboard recent-activity initial fetch race: in /app/frontend/app/admin/dashboard.tsx wait for the auth token to be ready before calling api.adminActivity() and api.adminStats(). Simplest fix: read `token` (or `ready`) from useAuth() and gate the useEffect on it, or add a small retry-once on 401.
Migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` (search /app/frontend for shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius).
Migrate the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` (only 1 hit seen on register flow — grep `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/app).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth context: admin dashboard depends on api client having the token set at first mount — consider exposing a `ready` boolean in auth context and gating admin screens on it to eliminate 401 races.
Feed testIDs use raw category keys (`feed-chip-all|tip|remedy|yoga`) while UI labels are localized. Documenting this in a README or renaming to match user-facing labels would help future testers.
server.py logs a 401 on the admin dashboard's first activity fetch — either the client should not fire until authed or the api util should queue calls until token exists.

success_rate.frontend: 23/24 = 95.8% (only admin dashboard's initial 'recent activity' render was empty due to a token race; sub-screen works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend preview: https://swasth-daily.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Auth: JWT in localStorage key `vaidhyaji.token`, language in `vaidhyaji.lang`. Fresh Playwright contexts do NOT inherit localStorage between mcp_browser_automation invocations — you must sign in inside the same script. Register endpoint requires .example.com emails (EmailStr rejects .test). OTP screen accepts any 4 digits. Slot testIDs are `slot-<iso>`. Feed chip testIDs are `feed-chip-{all|tip|remedy|yoga}` (NOT localized labels). Chatbot + support-chat use Claude Sonnet 4.5 (~5-12s per reply). If any modal button click fails with 'outside of viewport', use JS click via page.evaluate — several bottom-sheet CTAs on doctor detail / records / reminders sit below the mobile fold. Admin dashboard shows 6 stat cards; recent-activity list may need one refresh after login due to a token race.
rca_of_issue: Empty recent-activity on admin dashboard: the useEffect in /app/frontend/app/admin/dashboard.tsx calls api.adminStats() and api.adminActivity() at mount. When the admin login navigates to /admin/dashboard, the auth context sets the token via AsyncStorage/setState but the api util's Authorization header may not yet reflect the new token for the first fetch (single 401 seen in console). Stats card values render because the second render cycle refires the effect — but activity is a separate call that saw 401 first and set activity=[] which then never retries. Mitigation: gate the effect on `token`/`ready` from useAuth, or add a one-shot retry on 401 in the api client, or use SWR/react-query with retry.
